summary: The suite's sign-in app and admin group now carry clear, standard names.

new.title: Standard name for the suite's app
new.text: The suite's app in Microsoft Entra is now named Entra Policy Suite. Your next install run renames an older one in place, so nobody loses access.

new.title: Database admin group gets the standard name
new.text: An admin group still named after the old product name is renamed in place. A group you named yourself keeps its name, and the install lists every rename.
